videos.title: Resumen del fútbol
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Resumen del fútbol.

Rooney says he considered taking his own life at Man Utd.
Wayne Rooney says he considered taking his own life during his playing days at Manchester United and was "speaking to a therapist to try and figure out what was up".
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Ronaldo, Maradona, Baggio - what happened to the World XI?.
Football's biggest stars used to turn out in their prime for the Rest of the World XI, something that would not seem possible today.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Blackburn boss Mowbray steps back over health issues.
Blackburn Rovers head coach Tony Mowbray steps back from his role with the Championship club due to health issues.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

London City's Goodwin gets first England call-up.
London City Lionesses forward Izzy Goodwin is named in the England squad for the first time for the World Cup qualifying play-off against Ukraine.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Will Infantino feel he's already won as Fifa challengers are revealed?.
Uefa has finally identified a candidate next year's Fifa presidential election, but can anyone stop Gianni Infantino from winning?
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Actualidad internacional.

Romario demands Ancelotti sacking as war of words continues.
Romario, Brazil's fourth-highest scorer behind only Neymar, Pele and Ronaldo publicly demands that legendary manager Ancelotti be relieved of his duties.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Why always him? The rise and fall of Balotelli.
Fifteen years since his 'Why always me?' Manchester derby T-shirt celebration, BBC Sport looks at the career of former Manchester City striker Mario Balotelli.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Hincapie in advanced talks over new Arsenal deal.
Arsenal are in advanced talks with defender Piero Hincapie over a new contract.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Owono did not deserve 12-match ban - Pique.
FC Andorra owner Gerard Pique says goalkeeper Jesus Owono did not deserve the 12-match suspension he received following his challenge which resulted in the death of Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

'Why not have a go?' - the halfway line goal phenomenon.
Why Premier League players are trying their luck on goal from long range more regularly.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Últimas noticias del fútbol.

Almost impossible for Scotland to not qualify for Euro 2028... or is it?.
BBC Scotland picks its way through the permutations in Scotland's pursuit of Euro 2028 qualification.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Man convicted for racist abuse of Real Madrid's Mbappe.
A man has been convicted of a hate crime after directing racist insults at Real Madrid forward Kylian Mbappe during a La Liga match at Real Oviedo in 2025.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Pochettino says he would tell Guardiola to take USA job.
Mauricio Pochettino says he would tell Pep Guardiola to take the United States job if the former Manchester City manager was ever offered it.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Life after Ronaldo - Portugal face post-Bale Wales.
As Portugal adapt to life without the great Cristiano Ronaldo, they face a Wales side further along in their post-Gareth Bale era.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Are Scotland still too reliant on 'old guard'?.
After a bruising defeat in Switzerland to conclude Scotland's Nations League campaign, questions are being asked about the direction of travel under new head coach Sebastien Pocognoli.
Fuente: BBC Sport.
